sample_unit: patients (consecutive routine portal venous chest CTs)
models_evaluated: CE-certified and FDA-approved AI algorithm for pulmonary embolism detection (unnamed)

links.outcome: AI vs initial radiologist report diagnostic performance for incidental PE on same CTs
links.effect: Sensitivity 95.5% vs 62.7% (p<0.001); specificity 99.6% vs 99.9% (p=0.012); false positives 11 vs 2; PPV 85.3% vs 95.5% (p=0.047); AI found 25 additional unreported PE.
links.quote: Sensitivity of the AI algorithm was significantly higher than the outcome of the initial report (respectively 95.5% vs. 62.7%, p < 0.001), whereas specificity was very high for both (respectively 99.6% vs 99.9%, p = 0.012).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing the standalone diagnostic accuracy of a commercial AI tool against original radiologist reports for incidental pulmonary embolism detection.
